name: Avila
subject: A thin grown man of about 21, clearly an adult, with light olive skin and black hair tied up in a short punk topknot, clean-shaven; a long narrow face with a wide jaw, a thin hooked nose, heavy-lidded dark eyes with dark circles under them and a few old acne scars. A scout, a night owl, guarded and vengeful. He wears a work jacket over a collared shirt, a leather apron and a short wool mantle across the shoulders. Lightly weathered. Facing three-quarter left.
pose: Arms crossed, the shoulders turned a little away, a wary sidelong look.

name: Soot
subject: A reptilian saurid woman of about 38: her whole face and neck covered in fine pale grey scales, small fin-like frills in place of ears, a crest of light teal quills instead of hair, amber eyes with slit pupils, a flat nose and thin lips on a narrow face; slim. A former glitterworld surgeon, calm and precise, with a sharp focused gaze. She wears a fur pelt coat over a plain T-shirt and a leather apron, a short mantle on the shoulders. Facing front.
pose: Standing upright and still, hands clasped calmly in front at the waist, a steady direct gaze.

name: Ape
subject: A thin woman of about 48 with light olive skin and a short white afro; a weathered oval face with a pointed chin, a broad flat nose, deep crow's feet and a small scar through one eyebrow. A herder raised in caves, quietly gifted, with a warm but wary look. She wears padded cloth armour under a heavy parka and a string of beads. Facing three-quarter right.
pose: One hand gripping a wooden herding staff at chest height, the head tilted slightly, a guarded half smile.

name: Trorgakoc
subject: A dark elf man of about 28: pale, almost porcelain skin, long straight jet-black hair, long pointed elven ears; a long narrow face with high sharp cheekbones, a pointed chin, a slightly crooked nose and a lopsided easy grin. A warrior, simple and good-natured, lean and strong. He wears dark leather armour over a tunic and a dark cape. Facing three-quarter left.
pose: A sword resting on one shoulder, standing at ease, an easy grin.

name: Lorena
subject: A merfolk woman of about 27 from the coast: deep brown skin with a scatter of lighter speckles across the cheeks like a fish's, delicate fin-like ears, reddish-brown hair in a sleek swept style; a round face with a pointed chin, a wide nose and full lips. A sea shaman with a kind, attentive look. She wears simple sea-shaman garb with shell and cord ornaments. Facing front.
pose: Holding a carved shell charm in one hand at chest height, leaning slightly forward, listening.

name: Darunia
subject: A dark elf woman of about 23: pale skin, long straight black hair, long pointed elven ears; a heart-shaped face with a sharp upturned nose, high arched brows, a mole above the lip and a thin old scar along the jaw, a flirtatious half smile. An archer and fire-keeper. She wears ornate dark armour with pauldrons over a quilted vest and a sheriff's shirt, a bandana around the neck. Facing three-quarter right.
pose: A longbow slung over one shoulder, a hand on the string at her chest, the chin raised, a sidelong half smile.

name: Webb
subject: A woman of about 59 with dark brown skin and greying black hair in tight braids; a long narrow face with deep lines, a strong hooked nose, hooded eyes and a hard-set mouth. Tough and well travelled, a former private contractor. She wears a dark flowing robe over leather armour, a carved stone war mask hanging at her chest. Facing three-quarter left.
pose: Arms folded, standing square, the chin up, a hard level stare.

name: Bautista
subject: A man of about 33 with medium tan skin, freckles and messy bright red hair; a narrow face with a long straight nose, a heavy brow, a shadow of stubble and a slightly crooked jaw. A builder who became the colony's healer, quick to hold a grudge. He wears a heavy parka over a collared shirt and a scarf; a simple prosthetic arm of metal and leather shows at one shoulder. Facing front.
pose: Wiping his hands on a cloth, the prosthetic arm at his side, a sceptical frown.

name: Ettrian
subject: A dark elf man of about 28: pale skin, black hair gathered in loose bunches, long pointed elven ears; a gaunt face with sunken cheeks, a sharp nose and restless eyes with dark circles. A herder raised in a tribe, with a craving, restless look. He wears a woodland tunic and chainmail under spiked dark armour and pauldrons, a dark cape, a deer skull ornament on one shoulder. Facing three-quarter right.
pose: Hunched slightly forward, one hand gripping the cape at his throat, the eyes glancing aside.

name: Guido
subject: A man of about 40 with light olive skin and short dark auburn hair with a receding hairline; a soft round face with a pointed chin, a bulbous nose and kind, crinkled eyes. Clever, gentle with animals, slightly delicate, hard-working. He wears a fur pelt coat over a collared shirt and a leather apron, a belt hung with small capture balls. Facing front.
pose: Holding a small capture ball in an open palm and looking down at it with a gentle smile.

name: Luna
subject: A little girl of about two with light tan skin and short black hair in two small ponytails, chubby cheeks, a button nose and a gap-toothed grin, big curious eyes, in a small knitted wool sweater. Facing front.
pose: Holding a small wooden toy animal up to her chest in both hands, looking up.
